source_scope: Round 47 sequential review of printed Chapters 882–891; cumulative item ledger is EVENT-SOURCE-ITEMS-v4.7.csv; fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Xiao kills Uriel; hidden achievement rewards include Light God's Blood x1, Divine Crystals x10, Light Godfire x1, 100000 reputation; Uproot reaches 100%.
Saint Eight survives the God-Slaying Arrow and is captured; Saints Twelve and Fourteen escape using one Church Emblem.
Uproot 90% and 100% rewards delivered: Light Spear skill book, Divine Power Shards x50, Light Godhead x1, selectable Legendary Relic Box x1.
Three existing Light Codex volumes and 300 Divine Power Shards produce one Complete Light Codex.
One Light God's Blood is consumed to finish the existing Storm Axe's first awakening; relic box selection results in Annihilation Blood for Berje.
Berje consumes Annihilation Blood and an existing Legendary Heart, reaching Legendary. Cracatoa's blood fusion is deferred.
Isabella binds Complete Light Codex; Fortune Goddess's Favor S-rank quest accepted at 0/3; coordinates and staged rewards are objectives/offers, not receipts. Dream mist recedes.

Dream Layer activity ends at Day 152 00:00; squad handovers to Cao Xing report Dream Shards x105232, Dream Shards x82942, and Dream Crystals x247. His aggregate inventory panel then shows 7,592,345 Dream Shards and 2,162 Dream Crystals. The crystals convert to 2,162,000 Dream Shards; no shop purchase is confirmed before chapter end.

non_receipts: Church offer of 300 Divine Power Shards and one Godfire for Uriel was rejected.
The 300 shards spent in codex fusion are a cost, not a reward.
Fortune quest rewards are unclaimed; its third-stage reward is unknown.
The Light Godhead is not fused; the Light Spear skill is not learned in this batch.
No dream activity reward total is attributed to an individual.
The final 3,000,000 Dream Shard prompt for three Legendary Hearts is not confirmed as accepted; do not record the items as purchased.

inventory_snapshot.source_note: Aggregate balances include prior holdings and current activity receipts; they are not additional acquisitions.
